inlines.v: LAM'ANTIN, LAMB, noun lam. 1. The young of the sheep kind. 2. The Lamb of God, in Scripture, the Savior Jesus Christ, who was typified by the paschal lamb. Behold the lamb of God, who taketh away the sin of the world. John 1:1. LAMB, verb transitive To bring forth young, as sheep.
